gloss: to be wide-eyed (with surprise); to stare in amazement

definitions.gloss: to be wide-eyed with surprise; to stare in amazement
definitions.explanation: To open one's eyes wide due to surprise, shock, or amazement. Describes the physical reaction of eyes becoming round when startled or astonished.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧{目|め}を{丸|まる}くした。
examples.english: She was wide-eyed when she heard the price.

examples.japanese: {思|おも}いがけない⟦{再会|さいかい}→再会：11667_saikai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{目|め}を{丸|まる}くした。
examples.english: I stared in amazement at the unexpected reunion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦マジック→マジック：11392_majikku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧{目|め}を{丸|まる}くして⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The children were wide-eyed watching the magic show.

notes:
IDIOM STRUCTURE:
⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ (eyes) + ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ + ⟦{丸|まる}く→丸い：02967_marui⟧ (round) + ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to make)

Literally "to make one's eyes round" - describes the widening of eyes in surprise.

COMMON PATTERNS:
〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{目|め}を{丸|まる}くする - to be wide-eyed at ~
〜て{目|め}を{丸|まる}くする - to be wide-eyed upon ~ing

USAGE:
Indicates genuine surprise, not necessarily positive or negative. Can express:
- Pleasant surprise (unexpected gift)
- Shock at something unexpected (high price)
- Wonder and amazement (magic trick)
- Disbelief (unexpected news)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{目|め}を{見張|みは}る→目を見張る：21785_mewomiharu⟧ - to stare in wonder (often at something impressive)
- ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{疑|うたが}う→疑う：01889_utagau⟧ - to doubt one's eyes
- ⟦びっくりする→びっくりする：01178_bikkurisuru⟧ - to be surprised (general)
- ⟦{驚|おどろ}く→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧ - to be surprised/startled
- ⟦{唖然|あぜん}→唖然：09404_azen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to be dumbfounded

REGISTER:
Neutral. Natural in both spoken and written Japanese.
